correctness.rationale: A mean-zero solve of the explicit block graph Laplacian gives every transfer-current entry, with no symmetry assumption beyond the design Gram identities. All sign categories and counts are proved from exact block intersections; column signed sums equal 1 and diagonal entries equal (2v-1)/(kv), giving both exact induced norms. The degree switch, strict universal 5 and 6 bounds and projective-plane sharpness follow by algebra and prime-power construction. Exact rational grounded-Laplacian calculations checked complete matrices for (7,3,1), (13,4,1), (11,5,2) and (5,4,3). Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of the infinite family.

value.rationale: The object is a canonical complementability invariant of cut and circulation Banach subspaces, closely related to electrical-flow localization. The theorem gives an exact sign/multiplicity transfer-current law for every symmetric design even without edge-transitivity, and proves dimension-free universal sharp operator norm bounds 5 and 6, with projective-plane limit witnesses. It identifies an exact degree-four reversal in relative cut/cycle amplification. These are structurally motivated all-family statements rather than arbitrary small numerical evaluations.
